title: Exzeo Group Launches Exzeo Ventures to Build the Next Generation of AI-Native Businesses
summary: Exzeo Group Inc. (NYSE: XZO) today announced the launch of Exzeo Ventures, a new innovation division dedicated to developing AI-native products, services and businesses designed to reshape the future of insurance and beyond. While many organizations are focused on using artificial intelligence to improve existing workflows, Exzeo Ventures is being established with a broader mission: identifying opportunities that only become possible when AI fundamentally changes the economics. "Exzeo has always believed that technology creates the greatest value when it enables entirely new ways of solving problems and not simply doing yesterday's work faster," said Paresh Patel, Chief Executive Officer of Exzeo. "The launch of Exzeo Ventures reflects that philosophy. Its mission is to identify unmet customer needs, develop AI-native solutions, and create entirely new businesses that have the potential to transform industries." The division's primary focus will be on internally developed initiatives
